headline: Chip stocks slide, but the Dow ends higher
context: AI and chip stocks sank on new US tariff plans and hotter inflation data, but buyers returned late and the Dow closed higher.
chart_title: Every sector but health care rose

HPQ.text: Quarterly profit beat forecasts at $0.83 a share vs $0.74 expected, though its outlook for next year was cautious.

CHTR.text: No company news. Fellow cable firm Comcast also rose, but by much less.

AXON.text: No company news. Defence stocks gained too, with General Dynamics and Lockheed Martin also rising.

LRCX.text: No company news. Chip equipment makers led a broad sell-off in AI and chip stocks, with Applied Materials also falling.

ORCL.text: No company news. It fell with other AI-linked stocks, and software firms Datadog and Autodesk also dropped.

MU.text: BNP Paribas downgraded it to neutral, flagging a risk of too much memory supply, as chip stocks sold off.

watch.title: Thanksgiving
watch.text: US stock markets are closed all day.

watch.title: Half-day session
watch.text: US markets reopen after the holiday but close early, at 1pm ET.

question: Was today's late rebound a relief, or just a pause in the AI sell-off?
